tests/e2e/flows.py.name: Game flow tests
tests/e2e/flows.py.description: Plays real games in a phone-sized browser in every language: Help me against Hard, two players, reloads mid-game, the coach's wait, the loss screen, keyboard use and blocked storage.

tests/e2e/screens.py.name: Screen walk
tests/e2e/screens.py.description: Walks the eight screens in one language, comparing English words with the snapshot, checking no foreign words remain, each screen fits a small phone and the board never moves.

tests/e2e/screenshots.py.name: README screenshots
tests/e2e/screenshots.py.description: Takes the three phone pictures the README shows: the welcome screen, a hint on the first move and a two-player win in the dark.
